papers.title: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) of a Ni Alloy and its Components
papers.venue: 26th Advanced Aerospace Materials and Processes (AeroMat) Conference and Exposition (May 11–14, 2015)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦航空航天用镍合金SLM工艺，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳和多孔结构无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about SLM of a nickel alloy for aerospace applications, with no biomedical implant context, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing for implants, and no surface or osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究镍合金的激光选区熔化工艺
summary_zh.result: 实现了镍合金部件的成形

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the selective laser melting process for a nickel-based superalloy for aerospace components.
summary_en.method: The research employs SLM to fabricate nickel alloy parts and examines the resulting properties.
summary_en.result: The manufacturing of nickel alloy components via SLM is demonstrated.
summary_en.validation: No detailed validation is provided, likely relying on standard process characterization.

papers.title: Material Properties of AS7G06 Aerospace Components Built using Selective Laser Melting
papers.venue: 26th Advanced Aerospace Materials and Processes (AeroMat) Conference and Exposition (May 11–14, 2015)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦航空航天铝合多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合等生物医学关键点。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies an aerospace aluminum alloy (AS7G06) via SLM, with no biomedical context, no porous structure for stress shielding, no fatigue testing relevant to implants, and no osseointegration or surface roughness analysis.

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the material properties of AS7G06 aerospace components fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting (SLM) was used to build the components.
summary_en.result: Material properties such as density and mechanical behavior were characterized.
summary_en.validation: No explicit validation beyond material testing is reported.

papers.title: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) of Ti64 and Quality Control of its Products and Powder Feedstock
papers.venue: 26th Advanced Aerospace Materials and Processes (AeroMat) Conference and Exposition (May 11–14, 2015)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注Ti64选择性激光熔化的质量控制，未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover biomedical implant applications, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration. It focuses on process quality control of SLM without linking to implant performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Ti64合金选择性激光熔化工艺及其质量控制
summary_zh.method: 分析SLM工艺参数对粉末和产品性质的影响
summary_zh.result: 提出了对SLM产品和粉末的质量控制方法
summary_zh.validation: 未见具体验证，基于工艺分析

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the quality control of Ti64 products and powder feedstock produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Analysis of process parameters and their effects on product and powder properties in SLM.
summary_en.result: Proposed quality control strategies for SLM-produced Ti64 components.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation reported; based on process analysis only.
